claims: The Qwen provider client accepts only a plain authorization record containing exactly one enumerable own data property named authorized.
Authorization accessors, inherited fields, hidden fields, symbols, extra scope fields and non-object envelopes fail with QWEN_TTS_CALL_GATED.
Rejected authorization accessors are not invoked and rejected envelopes cannot reach fetch.
boundary: This qualification does not authorize or claim a real Qwen synthesis, retained media, deployment or production behavior.
